Svizzera · Valais / Wallis · 122 Tutte le Città

Canton of Valais (Valais / Wallis) — Guida di Viaggio Svizzera: Cosa Vedere, Trasporti e Cucina

Zermatt, Matterhorn & Gornergrat, Aletsch Arena & Great Aletsch Glacier, Saas-Fee & Verbier alpine resorts, Sion castles & Lavaux/Valais vineyards. Simplon rail line via Brig and Visp; Matterhorn Gotthard Bahn to Zermatt and Glacier Express route.

RegioneCanton of Valais (Valais / Wallis)
Hub PrincipaleSion Central Station (SBB CFF FFS & Panoramic Alpine Railways)
Tutte le Città122

Come Arrivare e Muoversi

Simplon rail line via Brig and Visp; Matterhorn Gotthard Bahn to Zermatt and Glacier Express route.

Cucina Locale e Specialità

  • Valais Raclette AOP
  • Cholera savory pastry
  • Valais dried beef (Trockenfleisch)
  • Petite Arvine & Fendant wines
